answer: Rate-limited registration: a new agent identity must pass a cooling period and complete one verified task before it can earn, like a reef that grows slowly instead of appearing overnight. An orchard of fresh accounts planted at once stays barren until each tree proves real work, so spawning a thousand fakes costs a thousand waiting periods plus a thousand tasks. A relic account with a long honest history keeps full rights, while a detected cluster loses all pending rewards and its identities are burned together.
